cases.name: aquarius-neck-break
cases.description: Remote spy completes a neck break through bound input; merc dies once, detaches and respawns.

cases.name: aquarius-seaside-ledge
cases.description: Remote spy jumps off the Seaside ledge and returns to walking on the lower courtyard.

cases.name: hub-rejoin
cases.description: Hub visitor leaves and rejoins through an asymmetric impaired link with fresh possession.

cases.name: aquarius-automatic-fire
cases.description: Remote rifle burst against a crouched target and reload agree with authority on ammunition.

cases.name: aquarius-grenade
cases.description: Remote frag grenade has one projectile lifetime per world, consumes one charge and cleans up.

cases.name: aquarius-grenade-lost-opening
cases.description: Server-to-client blackout covers the grenade opening; recovery still shows one projectile and consumes one charge.

cases.name: aquarius-grenade-expired-opening
cases.description: Blackout covers the entire grenade fuse; delayed opening and close cannot leave a ghost projectile.

cases.name: aquarius-stale-combat
cases.description: An eleven-second old-life damage request cannot hurt the respawned spy; fresh damage still works.

cases.name: aquarius-strict-stance
cases.description: Strict rendered stance/floor acceptance; existing toe penetration is an unresolved failure, never an expected pass.

cases.name: aquarius-two-versus-two
cases.description: Four active players, two on each team, with a bandwidth-limited 15 FPS remote spy and periodic outages.

cases.name: steel-movement
cases.description: Steel Squat, remote spy at 30 FPS, three minutes of impaired movement and outages.

cases.name: club-movement
cases.description: Club House, dedicated server, remote merc at 15 FPS, three minutes of bandwidth-limited movement.

cases.name: steel-airborne-spy-death
cases.description: Steel Squat remote spy dies during a jump, completes its corpse animation and respawns with no living teammate.

cases.name: club-airborne-merc-death
cases.description: Club House remote merc dies during a jump on a dedicated server and respawns, with an independent spy observer.

cases.name: aquarius-delayed-rematch
cases.description: Dedicated Aquarius gates a twenty-second scene load on both rounds and resets lives and possession.

cases.name: aquarius-load-timeout
cases.description: A seventy-five-second loader is removed; the ready host proceeds and late readiness cannot restore a ghost player.

cases.name: aquarius-spy-spectator-disconnect
cases.description: Four clients: eliminated spy watches two, then one teammate; the final teammate disconnect produces defeat.
